sentences.en: Both invited for the same evening.
He said to both: I shall come.
His wife said: that is not possible.
He went first to the first house.
They sat and ate very slowly.
He thought about the second house.
He said: forgive me, I forgot a thing.
He went out and ran to the second house.
There they had already eaten the meat.
Only bread remained on the table.
He went back fast to the first house.
There they had already taken the plates.
Juha sat and did not say anything.
His wife gave him bread and water.
